hints: Focus on the fraction of each 1 g sample that is actually iodine, not the total mass of the compound.
Calculate the $M_r$ of each compound, remembering that $\text{CaI}_2$ gives two iodine atoms per formula unit while the others give one.
Compare mass of iodine per gram using $\frac{\text{mass of I in formula}}{M_r}$, the smallest $M_r$ per iodine atom gives the most iodine.
walkthrough:
**Understand what most iodine means**

Think of each 1 g sample as a mixture. Only part of that mass is iodine, the rest is calcium, potassium, sodium or ammonium.

We need the largest mass of iodine in 1 g:
$$\text{mass of I} = 1\text{ g} \times \frac{\text{mass of I in one mole}}{M_r}$$

**Compare iodine content per gram**

For $\text{CaI}_2$ there are 2 moles of I per mole, for the others there is 1 mole of I per mole.

$$\text{CaI}_2: \frac{2 \times 126.9}{293.9} = 0.864 \text{ g I}$$
$$\text{KI}: \frac{126.9}{166.0} = 0.764 \text{ g I}$$
$$\text{NaI}: \frac{126.9}{149.9} = 0.847 \text{ g I}$$
$$\text{NH}_4\text{I}: \frac{126.9}{144.9} = 0.876 \text{ g I}$$

**Pick the winner**

$\text{NH}_4\text{I}$ has the smallest $M_r$ per iodine atom, so the least mass is wasted on the other ion.

That means 1 g of it contains the greatest mass, and therefore the greatest moles, of iodine.

options.A: 1 g of $\text{CaI}_2$ contains $2 \times 126.9 / 293.9 = 0.864$ g of iodine. This is high because there are two iodides per formula, but the heavy calcium and large $M_r$ still leave it slightly below the winner.
options.B: 1 g of $\text{KI}$ contains $126.9 / 166.0 = 0.764$ g of iodine. Potassium is quite heavy ($39.1$), so this gives the lowest iodine fraction of the four.
options.C: 1 g of $\text{NaI}$ contains $126.9 / 149.9 = 0.847$ g of iodine. Sodium is lighter than potassium so this beats KI, but it is still heavier than $\text{NH}_4$, so it loses.
options.D: 1 g of $\text{NH}_4\text{I}$ contains $126.9 / 144.9 = 0.876$ g of iodine. The $\text{NH}_4$ group has the smallest mass ($18.0$) of all the partner ions, so the $M_r$ per iodine is smallest and the iodine mass fraction is largest.
